newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups SCMP EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups SCMP EPS view.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Monday it had upgraded its earnings per share (EPS) forecast for South China Morning Post Holdings Ltd (SCMP) from HK$0.41 to HK$0.438 a share in 1997, and from HK$0.46 to HK$0.50 in 1998.

"In our view, SCMP offers investors a defensive play in a rising interest rate environment," Merrill said in a recent report, adding it had lifted its intermediate recommendation from neutral to accumulate.
It said SCMP should benefit from an 11 percent retail sales recovery and estimated 5.7 percent gross domestic product growth in 1997.
"We believe an annualised PE (price earnings ratio) of 16 times would reflect fair value for SCMP, which represents a possible 13 percent upside in share price appreciation.
In the longer term, it was an exciting story, with "rich cash coffers coupled with quality management with an acquisitional itch, likely to be in other media businesses", Merrill said.
Merrill said it had upgraded its 1997 net profit forecast by 6.6 percent from HK$710 million to HK$757 million, and 1998 profit view from HK$797 million to HK$864 million.
